provenance.note: Figures supplied in conversation, citing aggregators - FinancialFilings, Economic Times, Perivis, BazaarWatch, company investor pages - rather than read from a primary filing by this system. They carry a source but no document id, page or sentence, which is what the fact store requires before a figure may be quoted as disclosed. They are held here, outside company_facts, until the annual reports are ingested. At that point each one is either confirmed or contradicted, and a contradiction is a finding rather than an error to paper over.
